records.name: North Farallon Islands Special Closure
records.regulation_text_verbatim: Except as permitted by federal law or emergency caused by hazardous weather, no vessel shall be operated or anchored at any time from the mean high tide line to a distance of 1000 ft. seaward of the lower low tide line of any shoreline of the North Farallon Island and within 300 feet of any shoreline of the 3 southern islets which include the Island of St. James. No person except employees of CDFW, USFWS, NOAA or USCG during performance of their official duties, or unless permission is granted by CDFW, shall enter the area. Additional restrictions related to: boating speed limits, anchoring, seasonal closure, commercial diving operation exhaust procedures, and transit exist; see CCR T14 §632(b)(52) for details.
